$comment: Minimal reproducers found by the differential fuzzer (tools/fuzz). Blocks are made and signed by the spec-only oracle. `by` says how `expect` is read: first_code (the first refusal), includes_code, codes (exactly these, in order), subset (every key of expect matches), exact.

vectors.name: a block with no type is not canonical (not type_name)
refs.author as a set is refused, not a block that passes unchecked (chain: refs.author is one id)
a genesis whose kind is an object is refused by read
an accept by someone who is not a side of the deal is valid: the bytes are sound
and it binds nothing: the offer stays offered
a stop of an open offer by anyone but its author is valid: it counts for nothing in the fold
the stranger's stop does not stop the offer in the fold
a transfer whose amount is a bare number has no shape
a thing whose pack is a bare number has no shape
an actor with no author and no key is no genesis: it lacks the common five
a block sees the sm3: block it names
a block at seq 2^53 - 1 makes a chain that is not ok, without a list of 9e15 gaps
a 70 KB string where an id belongs is refused, and nothing overflows
